fp32_followup.native_flag_result: No dtype field in pinned PreTrainedConfig or SmolVLAConfig. policy.use_amp=false and accelerator.mixed_precision=no do not convert BF16 parameter storage. load_vlm_weights=false does not fix expert dtype because cached text_config still has torch_dtype=bfloat16.
fp32_followup.loader_semantics: PreTrainedPolicy.from_pretrained constructs cls(config), then safetensors.load_model calls model.load_state_dict without assign=True. Thus native reload casts FP32 checkpoint values into constructor-created BF16 expert tensors. An after-load float() would not recover precision already rounded during that load.
fp32_followup.correct_experiment_if_authorized: Explicitly documented wrapper/subclass constructs native model, casts only lm_expert tofloat32 BEFORE full checkpoint tensor load, leaves frozen VLM BF16 and existing F32 projections intact; casts before optimizer construction for training. Same construction hook required for every future reload. Fresh optimizer for experiment; saved native config cannot persist this custom policy dtype by itself. Do not present this as a stock flag.
fp32_followup.memory_estimate_limits: Tensor storage delta only; activation memory and throughput require a new bounded smoke measurement. Existing peak4.51GB suggests headroom onA100, but this is not admission.
fp32_followup.recommendation: Do not hold native48 dataset trial for speculative FP32 modification. No confirmed cache/alignment/processor defect. Native4000 same recipe isolates new data; chunk32 diagnostic directly tests observed delayed plans.
